name: @karaokething/desktop
description: Full-screen stage display for KaraokeThing: lyrics on the screen, sound through the speakers. Controlled from the host's admin panel.

scripts.check: node --check main.mjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check pages/setup.js && node --check pages/offline.js
scripts.ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run pack

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KaraokeThing Stage plays singers' microphones through the speakers when the host turns them on.
